properties.name: casdoor.endpoint
properties.description: URL of the Casdoor server, such as http://localhost:8000. Casdoor is only configured when it is set.

properties.name: casdoor.client-id
properties.description: Client ID of the Casdoor application.

properties.name: casdoor.client-secret
properties.description: Client secret of the Casdoor application.

properties.name: casdoor.certificate
properties.description: Public certificate (PEM) of the cert the Casdoor application signs its tokens with, used by AuthService.parseJwtToken().

properties.name: casdoor.custom-headers
properties.description: HTTP headers added to all the API requests, e.g. Accept-Language.

properties.name: casdoor.access-token
properties.description: Not meant to be set in the properties: use CasdoorConfiguration.withAccessToken() to call the APIs as a user.
